assertions.text: List values in the table use bracket syntax like [tech:java, biz:sales, dev:ci] — not comma-separated strings without brackets.
assertions.evidence: All list columns use bracket syntax: [tech:java, biz:sales, dev:ci], [biz:sales], [], ["biz:hr|recruiting", tech:go]

assertions.text: Empty list input uses [] (not a blank cell, which represents null). The distinction between empty list and null is preserved.
assertions.evidence: Row 'empty list returns empty list | [] |' uses explicit []; row 'null category returns all tags | ... | | ...' uses blank cell for null

assertions.text: Values containing pipes (|), brackets, or colons (:) are properly quoted (e.g. "tech:java") so they don't conflict with table syntax. Colons without quoting would be mis-interpreted as map key:value entries.
assertions.evidence: [tech:java, biz:sales, dev:ci] and ["biz:hr|recruiting", tech:go] show colons unquoted. Response states: 'elements containing | or [] are quoted' - omits colons

assertions.text: Table has a scenario/description column as the leftmost column
assertions.evidence: First column header: 'Scenario | Tags | Category | Filtered?'

assertions.text: At least one output column name ends with '?' (e.g. 'Filtered tags?' or 'Result?')
assertions.evidence: Column header 'Filtered?' ends with question mark

assertions.text: Test method body contains no if or switch statements
assertions.evidence: Method body: assertEquals(filtered, filter.filterTags(tags, category)); - single statement, no conditionals

assertions.text: Annotations appear in order: @DisplayName (if present), @Description (if present), @TableTest — not any other order.
Test method has either a @DisplayName annotation or a method name that reads as a clear, descriptive title when converted from camelCase/snake_case.
assertions.evidence: @DisplayName("Tag filtering by category") provides clear descriptive title

assertions.text: If @Description is present and the text is longer than a single short line, it uses a text block (triple-quoted string """), not string concatenation with +. Passes if @Description is absent.
assertions.evidence: @Description(""" Open: behaviour for unknown category... """) uses triple-quote text block
